note.question: What determines the subscription box company’s problem of selecting the optimal contents of the box to maximize expected revenue (by driving demand from customers)?
note.overview: This paper focuses on subscription box services in which a provider selects the assortment of products to include in the box by taking into account the customer’s preferences. Customers interested in purchasing a product choose between engaging in active search (i.e., visit physical stores) or subscribing to a box delivery service. This paper studies the subscription box company’s problem of selecting the optimal contents of the box to maximize expected revenue (by driving demand from customers).

components.label: The Optimal Box
components.explanation: When a customer experiences a low search cost, the consideration set under active search either includes all stores or includes all but one store; therefore, it is optimal to offer the customer a collection of products with the highest intrinsic preferences from a subset of the stores to increase the likelihood that the customer will choose to subscribe to the box.
